# runtime-profile

Renderer for `get_runtime_profile`: summary is `<worktree> · <kind> · top N`; opened, one table per span kind (count, avg/wait/self, recent max, max). A non-JSON result (error) shows as preformatted text.

<!-- AUTOGENERATED:BEGIN — do not edit; regenerated by `./equin build` -->

## Plugin reference

- Description: Renders get_runtime_profile MCP tool calls: the target worktree, kind and limit in the summary, and the slowest routes, queries and loaders as one compact table per span kind.
- Web:
  - Contributes: `renderer` "get_runtime_profile$" → `ParsedToolView`
  - Uses:
    - `conversations/conversation-view/jsonl-viewer/tool-call.JsonlViewerTool`
    - `conversations/conversation-view/jsonl-viewer/tool-call.ToolCallCard`
    - `primitives/css/scroll.Scroll`
    - `primitives/css/spacing.Stack`
    - `primitives/css/text.Text`
    - `primitives/data-table.ColumnDef`
    - `primitives/data-table.DataTable`
- Cross-plugin:
  - Uses tokens:
    - `ui/tokens/font-family --font-mono`
    - `ui/tokens/shape --spacing`
